metadata.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 PRO 7940HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
metadata.method: Two fresh-worker rounds per fixture/mode, baseline-candidate then candidate-baseline. Each worker warms for 300ms and records five batches of at least 100ms. GC precedes each batch. Separate 50-call heap sample at 4096 bytes includes collected objects. Keep rounds separate; timing and sampled allocation are observations, not CI thresholds.
